instruction: Thermostat Retrofit. At the start of the task, launch the OpenStudio application from `/usr/local/bin/OpenStudioApp` and open `init.osm`. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input file init.osm. Modify the model rather than replacing the task package with an unrelated file. Save the completed model as `/home/user/Desktop/result.osm`. Starting from init.osm, add one dual setpoint thermostat to each thermal zone, using simple heating and cooling setpoint schedules. The completed model must contain 1 building story, 2 spaces and 2 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: ZoneA and ZoneB. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 12 OS:Surface objects, split into 2 floor surfaces, 2 roof/ceiling surfaces and 8 wall surfaces. The surface outside-boundary counts should be 2 Ground, 8 Outdoors and 2 Surface. Do not add any windows or other subsurfaces. Include 0 ideal-loads air systems, 2 zone HVAC equipment lists and 2 dual-setpoint thermostats. Include simple metadata objects for schedules and loads: at least 4 schedule rulesets, 0 people loads, 0 lights loads, 0 electric equipment loads and 0 space type objects. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 12.00 m in X, 5.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.10 m. The total floor surface area should be 60.00 m2 within +/-0.75 m2 and the total exterior wall gross area should be 108.80 m2 within +/-0.75 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved OSM satisfies these stated requirements.
